# Viṣṇu and the industries that were always telling its story
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Viṣṇu**'s was unusually clear.

Viṣṇu's mythology grows from a minor Vedic solar figure into the preserver of the cosmos. Its center is movement: the three strides, the ten descents, the sleep between worlds.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Viṣṇu
- **Pantheon:** Sanskrit
- **Domain of influence:** Preservation, Protection, Universe
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** Insurance & Protection Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 259 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Three Strides.** In Ṛgveda 1. 154, Viṣṇu strides out three times. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Daśāvatāra.** The Purāṇas systematize Viṣṇu's descents into ten principal incarnations: Matsya the fish, Kūrma the tortoise, Varāha the boar, Narasiṃha the man-lion, Vāmana the dwarf, Paraśurāma the axe-bearer, Rāma the prince, Kṛṣṇa the cowherd, the Buddha, and the future Kalkī.  Each appears in a different cosmic age to counter a specific threat. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Insurance & Protection Services

*Insurance, assurance, and risk protection. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The preserver; protection of the cosmic order as a service.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Viṣṇu performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Disaster Resilience & Recovery

*Emergency management, recovery, and business continuity. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *As Matsya he carried Manu through the flood; the avatāra doctrine is divine crisis response.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The preserver at the center of living Hindu devotion.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Viṣṇu performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration

*Government, executive leadership, and statecraft. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *His avatāras set the template of dharmic rule; the ideal king and the divine counselor are both his descents.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Philosophy, Ethics & Standards

*Philosophy, ethics boards, and standards bodies. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The Bhagavad Gītā is his battlefield discourse on duty; the ethics syllabus begins on his chariot.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Viṣṇu performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Viṣṇu's mythology grows from a minor Vedic solar figure into the preserver of the cosmos. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in insurance & protection services, disaster resilience & recovery, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/vishnu/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
